heading: A calmer countdown for your workday
intro: Love how quickly the web app gets you started, but want the countdown to fit more naturally into your day? The desktop app stays in your menu bar or system tray, keeps counting in the background, and is always one shortcut away.

benefits.heading: Easy to glance at
body: Keep the time remaining in your menu bar or system tray. When you want the details, a global shortcut brings up the compact window without a trip through your browser tabs.

benefits.heading: Helpful, gentle reminders
body: The countdown and shift reminders continue after you hide the window. Launch at login, native notifications and a focused layout make it easy to keep around all day.

benefits.heading: Your data stays with you
body: Your hours, salary and preferences stay on your device. There is no account to create, and the app does not upload analytics or personal settings.

comparisonHeading: More than the web app in a desktop window
comparisonIntro: The desktop app keeps the web app’s core experience and adds shift planning, background reminders and floating tools for everyday use. Compare the details and choose what fits your workday.
